answer: Random pairwise cross-audit stops a nebula of fakes grading its own work. Each epoch, every agent gets two stranger auditors who re-run the task; a mismatch slashes the cheater's 40 POA bond to pay the auditor. One hundred fakes post 4,000 POA for 200 audits and lose the bond on each failed check; one honest agent posts 40 POA once and gets it back on passing. Each audit leaves an ivory record no fake can hide behind. The bar is a narrow ledge: honest work clears it, fake work falls.
